tasks.Analyze Crime Scene: Carefully examine and document the crime scene without altering evidence.
tasks.Refuse Questioning: Prevent any unauthorized personnel from asking questions until the scene is properly secured and analyzed.
tasks.Think About Crime Scene: Identify key elements of the crime scene that need to be preserved or documented before questioning witnesses or suspects.
